# CONTOSO


## Contoso Metadata Extraction Sample

This synthetic document demonstrates embedded metadata extraction from a document file. All
names, dates, and content are fictional and intended only for Azure SDK testing.

Embedded metadata fields: author, content type, creation date, language, page count, and title.
